headline: Sensex, Nifty extend losses as Middle East tensions fuel market uncertainty
summary: Sensex and Nifty recorded a fourth straight daily decline, led by selling in FMCG, financial and auto stocks. The fall was attributed to Middle East tensions, uncertainty over the US-Iran ceasefire and elevated crude prices.
why: The Sensex and Nifty are the benchmark indices for Indian equities, tracking large companies listed on the BSE and NSE. Crude oil prices heavily influence India's import bill.
why_moved: Fresh Middle East tensions, uncertainty over the US-Iran 60-day ceasefire and elevated crude prices drove selling in FMCG, financial and auto stocks.
